summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the resignation of CFO Oren Attiya, effective August 23, 2026, which the board accepted. Attiya served via a consulting agreement with CO-Finance. The board appointed CEO Haggai Ravid as interim CFO and principal financial and accounting officer, effective immediately. Ravid, 65, has extensive finance experience and previously served as CFO of Seamless Group. A search for a permanent CFO has commenced. The abrupt CFO departure and immediate interim appointment indicate leadership transition; watch for further management changes or strategic shifts.
